title: Senior Product Manager, Vehicle Data (Regional Growth) – EMEA
description:

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.
 
Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.
 
Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Senior Product Manager who will oversee product development from conception to launch across multiple products or segments and discover, develop, and cultivate new products and ongoing product enhancements that support Geotab’s business models and continued growth. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Senior Product Manager your key area of responsibility will be understanding the infrastructure needed to support the growth of revenue streams, owning the comprehensive product roadmap, and driving portfolio-level prioritization aligned with overall business strategy. You will need to work closely with UX designers, developers, data scientists, technical project managers, customers, and senior leadership.   • Drive prioritization at a portfolio level, aligning efforts with overall business and product strategy.

  • Design and implement feedback loops at scale, ensuring continuous alignment with market needs.

  • Lead complex problem and solution validation, ensuring strategic alignment and providing direction on critical solutions.

  • Oversee the translation of needs into detailed epics and initiatives, ensuring alignment with overall product strategy.

  • Work closely with technical project managers toward execution.

  • Collect and analyze feedback from customers, stakeholders and internal teams to continuously make improvements to products that are launched.

  • Lead efforts to enhance product management frameworks, mentoring other product managers and contributing to company-wide initiatives.

What you'll bring to this role:

  • 5 - 8 years of required experience in product management and/or customer discovery.

  • Bachelor’s degree or Post-Secondary Diploma/Degree (or equivalent work experience), with specialization in Engineering, Business, Computer Science, or a related field highly valued.

  • Demonstrated experience and strong understanding of user engagement metrics and product KPIs to drive data-informed decision-making and enhance product performance.

  • Strong proficiency in Agile planning methods, practices, and managing products through discovery, launch, and continuous review.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and virtual presentation skills, with the ability to stitch together disparate insights to uncover common patterns and communicate complex concepts clearly.

  • Strong strategic mindset, diplomacy, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills with comfort working in a flat organization.

title: Staff Engineer - Fullstack - Actions
description:
About Staffbase

We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.

Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.

As a Fullstack Staff Engineer on the Actions team, you'll take on one of our most important platform challenges: defining how extensibility works across Staffbase. Today, extensions power everything from HR integrations to the actions our AI assistant, Navigator, performs on a user's behalf — but there's no single, easy way to build and extend. That's what you'll design.

Your north star is a framework that our engineers, our Labs team, and eventually customers themselves can use to build their own extensions, whether that's a one-off integration for a single customer or a tier-one capability used across our entire base. You'll build the core, define the standards, and make the calls on where we standardise versus where we stay flexible, all on a mature, multi-tenant platform.

This is a role for someone who wants to drive, not just deliver, shaping the direction of a genuinely open-ended problem and setting the technical foundations others will build on.

As part of our tech stack, we are using: React.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Kotlin, Go, Java, MongoDB, Terraform, Docker and Playwright, to name a few.

Our environment

  • Working with skilled and like-minded professionals in a team that values diversity and inclusivity
  • We aim to create a flexible and agile work environment that promotes the well-being and work-life balance of our employees
  • We believe that team events during working hours play a vital role in building an exceptionally effective team, and we encourage them
  • We are enthusiastic about technology and committed to using it to improve the world
  • We follow the “You build it, you run it” approach and take pride in it

The Team

The Actions team sits at the heart of Staffbase's AI ambitions. We're the team that gives Navigator — our AI assistant and the main entry point into Staffbase — the ability to actually do things: submit a form, complete a task inside an integration, or take an action on a user's behalf through the agent. If Navigator is the brain, we build the hands.

That means two big things. First, we enrich what the AI can see and act on, our plugins, our widgets and the wider Staffbase platform so the assistant can do real work, not just talk about it. Second, we build the extensions that connect to the tools people already use, like Workday, Personio, ServiceNow and Microsoft.   We're not just shipping features, though. A core part of our mission is building the extensibility framework that lets others build too.  

Our environment

  • Working with skilled and similar-minded professionals in a team that values diversity and inclusivity.
  • We aim to create a flexible and agile work environment that promotes the well-being and work-life balance of our employees.
  • We are enthusiastic about technology and committed to using it to improve the world.
  • We follow the "You build it, you run it" approach and take pride in it.

What you'll be doing

  • Define and drive Staffbase's extensibility strategy, designing the framework, SDK and standards that let our teams and customers build their own extensions and integrations
  • Build the core systems that enable our AI assistant to take action across Staffbase and connect to external providers.
  • Lead technical strategy and architecture
  • Influence technical decisions and their documentation, driving long-term sustainable solutions to accommodate future growth and requirements
  • Continuously improve and refine our development processes, CI/CD pipeline, and automation practices to foster a productive development experience
  • Take ownership of major technical decisions, proactively addressing system bottlenecks and ensuring product quality
  • Contribute to and maintain technical roadmaps with engineering leadership to align project priorities and business goals
  • Manage and prioritize projects and initiatives across multiple teams
  • Foster a culture of ownership, technical excellence and continuous improvement within the team
  • Role modeling and developing others in the craft of Product Software Engineering
  • Mentor and guide engineers, providing leadership, feedback and fostering growth through code reviews and technical discussions

What you need to be successful

  • Proven track record as a Staff Engineer or Technical Lead with strong leadership and problem-solving skills
  • Proven experience designing and building extensibility within a B2B / enterprise platform, SDKs, plugin systems, or extension frameworks that let internal teams and external customers build on top of a core product, with the judgment to define what "good" extensibility looks like from the ground up
  • Deep understanding of multi-tenant architecture, with strong judgment on where to standardise versus where to stay flexible in platform design
  • Extensive experience with Java/Kotlin or Go on the backend and React on the frontend
  • Knowledge of architecture and design patterns
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Ability to drive technical direction, including making decisions on architectural trade-offs and evaluating the long-term impact of technical choices
  • Experience managing architecture projects across multiple development teams, aligned with their roadmaps and stakeholders
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to various stakeholders, both technical and non-technical
  • Previous experience working alongside Product and Design Leaders to deliver customer value in an Agile environment
  • Passion for building high-quality software
  • Passion for diversity and inclusion, and the ability to foster a culture where the team can move forward at speed while ensuring that everyone's voice is heard and they can contribute their best

What you'll get 

  • Competitive Compensation - we offer attractive salary packages including LTIP (unit-based Long Term Incentive Plan)
  • Flexibility - we offer flexible working time models and the option of hybrid work, and support this with a yearly flex work allowance of €1560
  • Recharge - with 31 vacation days annually (incl. one floating holiday), plus pro rata fully paid Fridays off during August
  • Support - we offer offering a company pension scheme
  • Volunteers Day - you’ll get one day off per year for supporting a social project

title: Senior Partner Engineer
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

 

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

 

About the team 

The Partner Engineering team’s vision is to establish Roku as the preferred platform of choice for our partners (media companies) to distribute and monetize their content globally. The Partner Engineering team’s mission is to be the technical advocate and point of contact for the Partner’s Engineering organization within Roku to help them deliver the best content viewing experience globally for the Roku user community. On a day-to-day basis, we work with engineers from partners organization to help them develop, test, certify, and launch partners direct-to-consumer (DTC) apps in compliance with the Roku platform distribution agreement. We represent partners’ roadmap and technical needs by working cross-functionally with the assigned Partner Engagement Managers, product and engineering teams within Roku. 

About the role 

Roku's platform is live across the multiple European countries, and our European footprint is growing — through Roku TV licensing partners, through our own streaming hardware, and through the local broadcasters and streaming services that make the platform worth owning in each market. 

You will be the senior engineer for our European partners: the person who makes their apps fast, stable and certifiable on Roku, who represents their technical constraints to our platform and OS teams, and who makes each new market launch a technical success rather than a scramble. 

You will be the engineer for a portfolio of European partners — public service and commercial broadcasters, subscription streaming services and pay-TV operators — working with the Partner Engineering team in San Jose and with the Partner Engagement Manager in London who owns those partners’ relationships. You will debug crashes, memory and launch-time issues, diagnose partner-reported streaming problems, and give your partners hands-on support through Roku certification. 

How you’ll work with the Partner Engagement Manager. The Partner Engagement Manager from Roku owns the partner relationship, the launch plan and timeline, partner priorities, and communication during incidents. You own the technical diagnosis, the integration work, and technical sign-off on certification and launch readiness, working engineer to engineer with the partner’s technical team. When something breaks, the Partner Engagement Manager coordinates the response and keeps the partner informed; you find the root cause and the path to a fix. 

Level: Senior individual contributor, with no direct reports. 

Reports to: Director, Partner Engineering, based in San Jose. 

Location and work arrangement: London, UK, in the office Monday to Thursday, with flexible Fridays. Travel within Europe up to 40% of your time. Regular late-afternoon calls with San Jose, whose working day starts at 4pm UK time. 

On-call: For major partner launches and live events, the Partner Engagement Manager is the on-call escalation point and brings this role in for technical diagnosis, which can mean occasional work outside normal hours. 

Expected impact: European partners’ apps pass certification and launch without technical surprises. Additionally, you’ll own the stability, performance and engagement metrics for your partners' apps, and keep each at or better than its benchmark: Roku's certification thresholds and the best-performing apps on the platform. 

  • Stability: crash rate, unexpected app closures and out-of-memory terminations 
  • Performance: launch time, video start time, video start and playback failures, and rebuffering 
  • Engagement: streaming hours per subscriber 
  • App Certification and public release: time from technical onboarding to launch in each new market 
  • Incidents: platform-caused incidents affecting your partners' apps, and time to resolve them 

What you'll do 

European market expansion 

  • Sign off the technical readiness of each new market launch. The Partner Engagement Manager owns the launch plan and timeline; you work with Channel Publishing and Certification to get global and local broadcasters and streaming services onto the platform ahead of a market opening — scoping integrations, running technical onboarding, and clearing the issues that would otherwise surface on launch day. Then write down what “technically ready” meant for that market, so the next launch is faster and cheaper. 
  • Represent regional technical requirements inside Roku engineering. European partners hit constraints that do not exist in North America: built-in broadcast TV tuners on Roku TVs, accessibility obligations, rules on how prominently European content is shown, privacy rules for viewing data, and regional differences in content protection and delivery. You will work out what each means technically, and turn it into concrete platform requirements, feature requests and firmware bugs — and follow them to resolution. You don’t need to be an expert in each regulation but should be capable to work cross-functionally with Roku legal, product, engineering to drive these requests to resolution, 
  • Help European partners integrate Roku Pay, working with Roku technical teams: you advise partners on their integration, debug it, and test European purchase flows for multi-currency pricing, VAT and invoicing expectations, strong customer authentication (PSD2/SCA) at purchase and re-authentication, and local payment method coverage.

Core Partner Engineering

title: Lead Engineer/ Architect (.NET) - Finance Group
description: This is a remote position. About Embrace Finance Group Embrace Finance Group, the financial-services division of Embrace Software Inc., helps every institution - from regional banks to local credit unions - deliver the speed, intelligence and experience customers now expect in a digital world. Today we serve nearly 450 financial institutions and hundreds of local government agencies. We are building an AI-led unified financial services platform spanning digital banking, document automation, item processing and branch modernization, engineered in partnership with the Embrace AI Group. The next generation of our online banking solution is a cornerstone of that platform - and this role will lead it. The Role We are hiring a Lead Engineer/ Architect (.NET), a hands-on technical leader who will accelerate the build-out of the next generation of our online banking platform for US Banks and credit unions on ASP.NET Core and C#. You will spend a significant portion of your time writing production code and owning architecture, while also mentoring engineers and setting the technical bar. You will partner day-to-day with Finance Group technology leaders on product and delivery, the Embrace Technology group on shared architecture, cloud and DevOps standards and Venture Labs / the Embrace AI Group to bring emerging capabilities into the platform. At its core this is a forward-deployed engineering (FDE) practice with an AI-first, new-product mandate. You will embed with financial institutions and internal product partners, turn ambiguous problems into shipped product and lead a small team of highly empowered, highly skilled engineers who take ideas from conceptualization to launch in weeks - not quarters. You will go full-stack from modern UX/UI through public REST APIs down to a .NET control plane and treat large language models and agentic AI services as first-class building blocks of the platform rather than bolt-ons. Key Responsibilities Architect and hands-on build the new ASP.NET Core / C# online banking platform - system design, service boundaries, data modeling and API contracts. Design and implement critical features and platform components; lead code and design reviews, setting the technical bar. Lead and mentor a small agile team - run sprints, unblock engineers, own delivery commitments, coach through 1:1s and pair programming. Partner with Finance Group technology leaders, product, QA and security to translate business and regulatory needs into robust solutions. Collaborate with the Embrace Technology group on shared architecture, cloud and CI/CD standards and with Venture Labs / Embrace AI Group to embed AI capabilities (AI-assisted dev, predictive insights, fraud/risk monitoring) into the platform. Drive engineering best practices - testing, CI/CD and adoption of modern AI dev tools. Operate as a forward-deployed engineer - embed with internal product partners to co-design solutions, then rapidly conceptualize, prototype and launch new products, compressing concept-to-production from quarters to weeks. Lead AI-first, new-product development end-to-end - design and ship LLM- and agent-powered capabilities using services such as Google Vertex AI / Gemini, OpenAI (and Azure OpenAI) and orchestration frameworks like LangChain, with disciplined evaluation, guardrails and cost / latency management. Build full-stack and real-time - modern, accessible UX/UI, public REST APIs and live experiences via SignalR on .NET Core / C# control plane, with event-driven services through Azure Service Bus / messaging, etc. Own the cloud and delivery foundation - infrastructure-as-code with Terraform, CI/CD on GitHub (Actions) and containerized, repeatable deployments across Azure and/or AWS. Engineer security and compliance in by design - identity and access management (OAuth2 / OIDC, SSO, MFA), secrets management and data protection aligned to PCI DSS, SOC 2 and FFIEC, with auditability from day one. Build and empower the team - recruit, coach and unblock a small squad of progressive FDEs, giving them the autonomy, tooling and technical bar to ship safely and fast. How We Work - Forward-Deployed & AI-First Small, empowered squads: highly skilled FDEs own outcomes end-to-end, from conceptualization to launch, with minimal hand-offs. AI-first by default: LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows are first-class both as design tools and as product capabilities - we prototype with AI, evaluate rigorously and ship. Fast and safe: short iteration loops, trunk-based development, automated testing, infrastructure-as-code and progressive delivery behind feature flags. Polyglot pragmatism: .NET / C# anchors the control plane; we use the best-fit language or service elsewhere and optimize for outcomes, not dogma. Our Stack & Tooling Control plane & services: .NET (ASP.NET Core, C#), public REST APIs, SignalR for real-time, Azure Service Bus for messaging and eventing. AI & LLM: Google Vertex AI / Gemini, OpenAI / Azure OpenAI, LangChain and similar orchestration; vector stores, RAG, plus evaluation and guardrail tooling. Cloud & platform: Azure and/or AWS, Terraform for IaC, GitHub + GitHub Actions for CI/CD and containers. Front-end: modern, accessible UX/UI (Angular / React). Identity, security & compliance: IAM (OAuth2 / OIDC, SSO, MFA), secrets management, PCI DSS, SOC 2 and FFIEC. Data: Microsoft SQL Server today, with modern data stores adopted as the platform evolves. Requirements 5+ years building modern, data-intensive .NET web applications, with a proven tech-lead / lead-developer track record and direct team ownership. Polyglot. Expert-level C# and .NET (Framework and modern .NET / Core); strong SQL and Microsoft SQL Server; solid REST API experience at scale. Proven experience in financial services / online banking, with strong preference for platforms serving US Banks, credit unions, or other regulated FIs. Front-end experience with modern Javascript/UI frameworks like Angular / React. Familiarity with classic frameworks like ASP.NET, Razor templates, Htmx, Bootstrap, Orchard Core, etc is a strong plus for modernizing. Experience with cloud (Azure, AWS), DevOps and CI/CD; understanding of US banking security and compliance (PCI DSS, SOC 2, FFIEC guidance). Strong communicator across engineering and business stakeholders (Finance Group, Embrace Technology, Venture Labs); excellent ownership and problem-solving. Comfortable in a highly remote, fast-paced, agile environment. Bachelor's in CS, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). Demonstrated 0→1 product delivery at speed - ideally in a forward-deployed, customer-embedded, or startup / venture environment. Hands-on AI/LLM application development - prompt and context engineering, RAG and agentic patterns on at least one major platform (Vertex AI / Gemini, OpenAI, or Azure OpenAI) with orchestration such as LangChain and a pragmatic grasp of evaluation, guardrails and cost. Real-time and event-driven experience - SignalR, Azure Service Bus or equivalent messaging - and public REST API design at scale. Strong platform / DevOps depth - Terraform (IaC), GitHub Actions CI/CD, containerization and multi-cloud (Azure and/or AWS). Identity, security and compliance depth for regulated FIs - IAM / OAuth2 / OIDC, SSO / MFA, secrets management and PCI DSS / SOC 2 / FFIEC. Benefits Competitive salary commensurate with experience; 100% remote with autonomy. Career advancement across the Embrace portfolio; the chance to shape a platform used by hundreds of US banks and credit unions with the Embrace AI Group and Venture Labs. A high-autonomy, AI-first engineering culture where small teams of empowered FDEs take ideas from concept to launch - and see them used by hundreds of US banks and credit unions.
